snapshot.text: Mixed public-private system building universal health coverage (CMU) through mandatory enrolment. The government aims for 30 million people enrolled in 2026 and is now focused on turning enrolment into actual coverage.

minister.name: Pierre Dimba
minister.role: Minister of Health, Public Hygiene and Universal Health Coverage

priorities.title: CMU: from enrolment to coverage
priorities.text: Target of 30 million enrolled in 2026, with a push to make coverage effective.

priorities.title: Digital health and pharmaceutical sovereignty
priorities.text: World Bank support focuses on CMU, digital health and local pharmaceutical production.

priorities.title: One Health
priorities.text: The minister argues for a One Health approach to environmental health challenges.
